The left chart is labeled “LLaMA-3.1-8B”; the right is labeled “Qwen-2.5-7B.” Each chart has nine spokes for LoCoMo F1, LoCoMo B1, LoCoMo J, MSC F1, MSC B1, MSC J, LongMemEval F1, LongMemEval B1, and LongMemEval J. Concentric grid rings mark a radial scale from the center to 70, in increments of 10. Each series’ circular data marks are joined by lines to form a polygon; there are no arrows. Values are read-offs estimated from the plotted marks. In both panels, PPO and GRPO are generally outside (higher than) Base, with the largest gaps visible on some LongMemEval spokes. PPO is often the outermost series; the series are closer together on several LoCoMo and MSC spokes.
